title: Amazon S3 object storage (buckets, durability, security, events) — concept map
intro: S3 is object storage: buckets hold objects addressed by keys. Prefixes organize keys like folders but are not true directories. Eleven nines durability, strong read-after-write for new objects, storage classes for cost tiers, policies for access, and events for serverless pipelines.

conceptCards.title: Keys & prefixes
conceptCards.summary: Flat namespace; prefix is key substring before delimiter. No real folders.

conceptCards.title: Durability
conceptCards.summary: 99.999999999% durability; strong consistency for new PUTs since Dec 2020.
conceptCards.example: Cross-Region Replication for DR not backup substitute

conceptCards.title: Storage classes
conceptCards.summary: Standard, IA, Glacier tiers — lifecycle transitions by age or prefix.

conceptCards.title: Security
conceptCards.summary: Block Public Access default. Bucket policy + IAM. SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS.
conceptCards.example: Deny unencrypted PutObject in bucket policy

conceptCards.title: Events & hosting
conceptCards.summary: s3:ObjectCreated:* to SQS, SNS, Lambda. Static website for SPA behind CloudFront.
